svg.text: Plant engineering: CFIHOS 2.0 and DEXPI 2.0.1 ontology

13 nodes · 7 relationships · 0 implied labels, generated from crosswalk.json, from the model.json of CFIHOS 2.0, DEXPI 2.0.1. The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the term in its standard.
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: SAME_AS: cfihos:Company skos:narrowMatch dexpi:Enterprise. A CFIHOS company is any legal entity in the handover, the owner and operator as well as contractors, manufacturers and suppliers; a DEXPI enterprise is the ISA-95 enterprise at the top of the plant breakdown, i.e. the owner or operator. The enterprise is the narrower of the two. Linked nodes share companyName and enterpriseName.
SAME_AS: cfihos:Site skos:closeMatch dexpi:Site. Both are the geographical site a plant stands on; DEXPI defines it as ISA-95 does. Linked nodes share siteCode and siteIdentificationCode, siteName.

SAME_AS: cfihos:Plant skos:closeMatch dexpi:ProcessPlant. Both are the assembly of equipment performing a process, the root of the plant's functional breakdown: a CFIHOS plant decomposes into process units and tags, a DEXPI process plant into plant sections, systems and trains. Linked nodes share plantCode and processPlantIdentificationCode, plantName and processPlantName.

SAME_AS: cfihos:ProcessUnit skos:closeMatch dexpi:PlantSection. A CFIHOS process unit is the process engineer's breakdown of a plant into sub-functions; a DEXPI plant section, defined by ISO 10209, is the same level of the breakdown. Linked nodes share processUnitCode and plantSectionIdentificationCode, processUnitName and plantSectionName.

SAME_AS: cfihos:Area skos:closeMatch dexpi:PlantArea. Both are the physical area of a plant an item stands in; DEXPI defines it as ISA-95 does. Linked nodes share areaCode and plantAreaIdentificationCode, areaName and plantAreaName.

SAME_AS: cfihos:Tag skos:closeMatch dexpi:TaggedPlantItem. A CFIHOS tag is the specification of a function in the plant that equipment fulfils; a DEXPI tagged plant item is the same function as drawn on a P&ID. The tag name joins them. CFIHOS keeps the tag apart from the serialised equipment installed against it, which a P&ID doesn't show. Linked nodes share tagName.

SAME_AS: cfihos:Tag skos:closeMatch dexpi:MotorAsComponent. CFIHOS tags a pump's driver on its own, e.g. PM-2001A, with the pump as its parent tag; DEXPI draws the motor as a component of the pump, named by a sub-tag. The two describe the same motor, but share no identifier.

g.title: cfihos__Site — A geographical surface that can be identified on a map. Properties: siteCode, siteName, measurementSystemCode

cfihos__Plant — An assembly of equipment that perform a physical or chemical process, including production, transportation and storage. A Plant represents the 'high level' function to be performed, and during the design, a Plant is decomposed in Process Units and Tags. Properties: plantCode, plantName, siteCode, isoLanguageCode, measurementSystemCode, industrialComplexCode

cfihos__ProcessUnit — A decomposition of the 'high level' Facility function into more granular 'sub-functions'. This facility breakdown structure is decided by the process engineer. Properties: plantCode, processUnitCode, processUnitName
cfihos__Area — A geographical surface occupied by a Plant. A plant area is created to identify the physical location of an equipment within a plant. Properties: plantCode, areaCode, areaName

cfihos__Tag — An object designed for performing functional requirements and serving as a specification for equipment. Properties: plantCode, tagName, tagDescription, parentTagName, processUnitCode, areaCode, constructionAssemblyCode, commissioningUnitCode, maintenanceUnitCode, maintenanceSystemCode, corrosionLoopCode, tagClassName, tagStatus, tagRequisitionNumber, designedByCompanyName, productionCriticalItemIndicator, safetyCriticalItemIndicator, safetyCriticalItemGroupCode, safetyCriticalItemReasonAwarded, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName

cfihos__Company — A legal entity engaged in business as a proprietorship, partnership, corporation, or other form. Properties: companyName, manufacturerIndicator, supplierIndicator, companyContactPerson, companyContactPersonFunction, companyAddressLine1, companyAddressLine2, companyAddressLine3, isoCountryCode, companyTelephoneNumber, companyFaxNumber, companyEmailAddress
dexpi__PlantArea — An area as defined by ISA 95. Properties: id, plantAreaIdentificationCode, plantAreaName
dexpi__Enterprise — An enterprise as defined by ISA 95. Properties: id, enterpriseIdentificationCode, enterpriseName
dexpi__Site — A site as defined by ISA 95. Properties: id, siteIdentificationCode, siteName
dexpi__PlantSection — A plant section as defined by ISO 10209:2012. Properties: id, plantSectionIdentificationCode, plantSectionName
dexpi__TaggedPlantItem — A fully tagged item in a plant. Properties: id, tagName, tagNamePrefix, tagNameSequenceNumber, tagNameSuffix

dexpi__MotorAsComponent — A driver that is powered by electricity or internal combustion and is used as component of an apparatus or of a machine. Properties: id, nominalPower, nominalRotationalFrequency, subTagName
